mirror.heatmapHoverNote: Each square is a day; the darker it is, the more you learned that day.
mirror.heatmapEmpty: No traces yet. Start a learning chat and the first square appears here.
mirror.trendsEmpty: The lines appear as you learn.
mirror.trendLayersMemoryNote: An estimate of how many concepts you could still recall that day; without contact, it fades on its own over time.
mirror.trendLayersUnderstandingNote: The share of what you remember that is backed by your own explanation or by you saying you had learned it. Also an estimate.
mirror.trendLayersIntuitionNote: The roughest estimate: the part that has been stable for a long time and that you have used yourself in conversation.
mirror.trendWordsSettledLabel: Words stable for over a month
mirror.trendWordsMemoryNote: An estimate of how many words you could still recall that day; without contact, it fades on its own over time.
mirror.trendWordsIntuitionNote: The roughest estimate: words that have been stable for a long time and that you have used in your own sentences.
mirror.trendWordsSettledNote: Counts words that have been stable for over a month; new words take time to settle, so a flat start at zero is normal.
mirror.reunionOpener: Let's revisit "{{title}}". Say what you still remember about it in your own words — start wherever your memory starts, and I will fill in the rest.
mirror.evidenceClaimLearned: You said you had learned this
mirror.evidenceClaimFamiliar: You said you were fairly familiar with this
